title: strength-spotlight-narrative-calibration-asks
content:
Context: quick internal note for my 1:1 with Lina (manager) and the upcoming calibration packet. Goal is to prepare 3 crisp stories that show impact, outline ask(s), and surface open questions. Keep narrative short (30-60s), then backup evidence. This is a personal scratch — rough fragments, bullets, and placeholders I will refine before sending the manager one-pager.

Role snapshot (current priorities):
- Lead on onboarding & new hire ramp (end-to-end) for Eng + Prod teams.
- Project lead for the onboarding microsite and mentor program.
- Partner with Recruiting to reduce time-to-fill for mid/Senior ICs.

High-level signal I want to communicate to calibration: influence beyond immediate scope, reliable cross-functional delivery, measurable process improvements, & readiness to lead a small program manager headcount.

Strength story A — "Onboarding time to productivity" (concise narrative)
- Situation: New hires were taking ~8-10 weeks to reach baseline productivity; feedback highlighted unclear success criteria and fragmented training.
- Task: Create a single onboarding playbook, introduce weekly milestone check-ins and a paired-mentor system; coordinate with Eng leads and DX.
- Action: Launched onboarding microsite (content + checklist), ran 4 pilot cohorts, created 1-pager manager expectations, and automated first-week reminders in Slack.
- Result / impact: Median ramp reduced from 10 -> 6.5 weeks (pilot cohort), onboarding NPS up from 62 -> 79 in pilot; mentors report 30% fewer escalation tickets in week 1.
- Evidence to attach: cohort_summaries_Q3-Q4.pdf, onboarding-nps-export.csv, pilot-retros.md (links in "linked_artifacts").
- Talking points for 60s: "Led cross-functional playbook and mentor program that shortened ramp by ~35%, improved new hire confidence (NPS +17 pts), and removed repetitive manager overhead in week 1."

Strength story B — "Closed-loop hiring ops improvements"
- Situation: High variance in time-to-fill and poor candidate experience flags from senior interviews.
- Task: Stabilize metrics and create repeatable interview guides for mid/senior IC roles.
- Action: Standardized role scorecards, introduced calibration rubrics for interviewers, trained 42 interviewers across Eng/Product, and added a candidate feedback pulse for each loop.
- Result: Average days to offer reduced 42 -> 35 days, offer acceptance rate up 4 pts, interviewer satisfaction (self-survey) improved from 3.6 -> 4.3/5.
- Evidence: hiring-metrics-Q4.png, scorecards-v1.docx, training-roster.csv.
- 1-line calibration cue: "Operationalized hiring (scorecards + training) that materially improved speed and consistency for mid/senior hires."

Strength story C — "Operational influence during crunch (platform incident)"
- Situation: November platform incident impacted onboarding pipeline (scheduling, access). Engineering leads overloaded.
- Task: Reduce disruption for hires and prevent missed start dates.
- Action: Spun up an incident-focused HR response lane, temporarily re-prioritized mentor pairings, set up daily sync with SRE and IT to clear access blockers within 24 hours.
- Result: Zero delayed start dates for impacted cohort; resolved 93% of access issues within the SLA window; cross-team praise from SRE lead in slack thread.
- Evidence: incident-response-log.pdf, slack-commendations.txt.

Signal framing & calibration language (short):
- "Consistent deliverer: cross-functional program lead who moves people/process changes from idea to measurable outcomes. Shows both operational rigor and influence over engineering habits."
- Suggested calibration label: "Solid IC with emerging program leadership / ready for IC+ responsibilities."

Asks (what I want from Lina / calibration):
- Short-term: explicit recognition in calibration notes of "reduced ramp" metric and "hiring ops" stability. (This helps slate for potential stretch assignment.)
- Medium: greenlight to pilot a 0.5 FTE Program Coordinator (6mo) to help operationalize mentor rotations and analytics. Budget ask rationale: frees ~6-8 hrs/week of my time to focus on strategic initiatives (quantify if needed).
- Long-term: consider a step toward IC-Lead / Program Lead career band in next cycle if hit milestones (ramp reduction sustained, 6-month mentor program retention > 80%).

Risks / open questions I should surface in 1:1 or calibration:
- Data maturity: some impact numbers come from pilot cohorts and imperfect signals (manual logs). Ask: do we need a tighter definition of "productive" (KT tasks completed vs manager subjective)?
- Attribution: multiple parallel changes (mentors + playbook + manager check-ins). How strongly will calibration credit the lead vs team context?
- Headcount ask timing: will calibration accept a 6mo contract / fractional role vs full FTE? Be ready with cost-benefit: projected manager-hours saved vs contractor cost.

Prep checklist before manager sync (my TODOs):
- Pull final cohort ramp numbers (Q4 pilot vs baseline) and put into single slide (due 2026-02-07).
- Export onboarding NPS raw responses and anonymize — pick 3 qualitative quotes.
- Collate peer shoutouts (Slack thread) into a one-pager.
- Draft the 2-sentence calibration blurb for Lina to copy into packet.
- Draft a 6-month program coordinator job description (1-paragraph).

Practice lines (for the actual 1:1):
- "Quick ask: I want calibration to call out the measurable ramp reduction and confirm permission to trial a 0.5 FTE coordinator for 6 months. I'll own the pilot details and show weekly signals."
- "What I want from you: two bullets in the calibration note — (1) impact on ramp, (2) operational influence across Eng + Recruiting — and a tentative thumbs-up on headcount pilot."

Notes to self (loose):
- Keep stories crisp; pick two metrics and one qualitative line per story.
- Avoid overclaiming — be clear about pilot vs org-wide rollout.
- Prepare the cost math for the coordinator ask (hours saved * manager hourly rate approximation).

Backups / attachments I will include in final packet: cohort_summaries_Q3-Q4.pdf, onboarding-nps-export.csv, hiring-metrics-Q4.png, scorecards-v1.docx, incident-response-log.pdf

Version history:
- 2025-11-12 initial scratch
- 2026-01-08 revised metrics after pilot clean-up
- 2026-02-03 refined calibration language and added ask rationale

End."
